schedule.title: Schedule

schedules.heading: Schedules
schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.intro: Export any plan's schedule to a CSV file (one row per day), edit it, and import it back as your own saved schedule.
schedules.importError: Could not read that file. Please pick a valid CSV.
schedules.importEmpty: No schedule rows were found in the file.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restartNote: You may need to reopen the app to fully mirror the layout for the new language.
settings.aboutBody: Track the cadence of your Quran reading or memorization and see when you will finish at your current pace.
settings.dataNote: Your data is stored locally on this device.

log.title: Activity log
log.empty: No activity yet. Create a plan and start logging your daily progress to build your history here.
